gloss: from partway through; from the middle (of)

definitions.gloss: from partway through; starting from the middle; from partway along
definitions.explanation: A set phrase meaning 'starting from some point partway through' something — an event, a story, a route, a process, or a period. Combines the noun {途中|とちゅう} (on the way; partway) with the starting-point particle から (from).

examples.japanese: {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧になった。
⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{途中|とちゅう}から⟦{面白|おもしろ}く→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The movie got interesting partway through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{途中|とちゅう}から⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I started listening to the story partway through, so I couldn't really follow it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧、{途中|とちゅう}から⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I was late to the meeting, so I ended up joining partway through.

notes:
A common fixed expression meaning 'from partway through (something)'. Formed by attaching the starting-point particle ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ to ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ (on the way, midway). Used for anything with a temporal or spatial progression — stories, events, journeys, processes.

USAGE:
When speakers want to indicate that some change or action began at a point after the start of something rather than at the beginning. Frequently used with change-of-state verbs (⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧, ⟦{面白|おもしろ}く→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧) and with verbs of joining or watching (⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧, ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧, ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to join partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ / ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to start watching / listening partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to start raining partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}く→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the road gets narrower partway along
- {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the topic shifts partway through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: on the way; in the middle (of doing) — marks a point within the duration; contrasts with から, which marks a starting point. 'I dropped by partway there' would be ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧, not {途中|とちゅう}から⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧.
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: up to partway; as far as partway — marks an ending point rather than a starting point
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the beginning — the natural antonym
- {始|はじ}め⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the start — near-synonym of ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧
